notes: requires_patch у символов взят из патчлиста как есть (CATEGORYMEM). Поле позиционное: например, таблицы CAN привязаны там к «Immobilizer Bypass», а id_maf_tab__v_maf — к «Boost Control». Рабочая привязка символа к фиче задана в MS43/policies/stage_policy.json (SYMBOL_OVERRIDES) и проверяется тестами.
Категории патчей в патчлисте перемешаны (см. PATCH_GROUPS) — source category хранится только для провенанса.
basedata отсутствует у 5 патчей (12 записей): снять их нельзя, только применить поверх стокового бэкапа.
[PATCH] Remove Deprecated Launch Control на чистом стоке 430069 — no-op (patchdata совпадает со стоком), нужен только для образов со старым LC v2.5.

patches.title: [PATCH] Immobilizer Bypass
patches.description: Disables the immobilizer checks of the ecu

patches.title: [PATCH] Immobilizer Bypass DTC Fix
patches.description: Fixes DTC 128 when the immobilizer is bypassed. | Will be combined with the bypass in the next release.

patches.title: [PATCH] Clear Immobilizer Data
patches.description: Clear all immobilizer related data to realign the ECU with EWS module via INPA. Requires bootmode flash!

patches.title: [PATCH] Checksum Bypass
patches.description: Disables both checksums for the calibration data section

patches.title: [PATCH] DS2 Baudrate Switch Engine Stopped Bypass
patches.description: EXPERIMENTAL: This patch makes baudrate switching possible when the engine is started.

patches.title: [PATCH] DS2 Logging Feature Enhancement
patches.description: This patch contains a new logging command (0B B0) that bundles the analog and digital commands and adds the following parameters: | - Ignition timing for all cylinders | - Fuel injector pulse width for bank 2 | - Calculated manifold air pressure | - Active VO table | - Filtered load values | - Calculated gear | - Rear O2 input voltage | - SA MAF input voltage | - DMTL input voltage | - Fuel cap input voltage | - RON adaptation | - Indexed Engine Torque

patches.title: [PATCH] DS2 Speed Increase
patches.description: This patch increases how often the ECU processes DS2 commands

patches.title: [PATCH] Remove Deprecated Launch Control
patches.description: Removes the old launch control feature of patchlist v2.5 and before from the binary

patches.title: [DATA] Remove Deprecated Launch Control
patches.description: Removes the old launch control data of patchlist v2.5 and before from the binary

patches.title: [PATCH] M Cluster LED Support
patches.description: This patch activates the LEDs in the M3 cluster to act like in an E46 M3

patches.title: [PATCH] MAF Sensor Hack 2048kg/h
patches.category: Boost Control Over Canister Purge Output
patches.description: Extend the airflow capability of the ECU to 2048kg/h. Use following tables to edit MAF sensor scale.

patches.title: [PATCH] MAF Sensor Hack 4096kg/h
patches.category: Boost Control Over Canister Purge Output
patches.description: Extend the airflow capability of the ECU to 4096kg/h. Use following tables to edit MAF sensor scale.

patches.title: [PATCH] Map Reduction
patches.description: This patch forces the ECU to use the '''tco_1''' tables thus reducing the amount of maps needed for tuning. |  | The following maps will be used during normal engine operation: |  | Injection: | Idle: ip_ti_tco_1_is_ivvt | Part Load: ip_ti_tco_1_pl_ivvt_1 & ip_ti_tco_1_pl_ivvt_2 |  | Ignition | Idle: ip_iga_tco_1_is_ivvt | Part / Full Load: ip_iga_tco_1_pl_ivvt |  | VANOS: | Idle: ip_cam_sp_tco_1_in_is & ip_cam_sp_tco_1_ex_is | Part Load: ip_cam_sp_tco_1_in_pl & ip_cam_sp_tco_1_ex_pl | Full Load: ip_cam_sp_tco_1_in_fl & ip_cam_sp_tco_1_ex_fl |  |  | ATTENTION: Be aware that the following tables can be used if there is an active error in the ECU: |  | Injection: | ip_tib__n__maf |  | Ignition: | ip_igab_is__n__maf | ip_igab__n__maf

patches.title: [PATCH] Ignition Cut Limiter
patches.description: This patch implements a basic ignition cut feature where the engine speed hard limiter changes ignition coil dwell time to zero. | This may damage your coils, center sprocket, or whole engine and exhaust system.

patches.title: [PATCH] Alpha/N
patches.category: No Lift Shift Parameters - Not Implemented Yet
patches.description: This patch implements code to use load values from MAF substitute table ip_maf_1_diag__n__tps_av.

patches.title: [PATCH] MIL Knock Indicator
patches.description: This patch implements a knock indicator that shows light or heavy knock events over the MIL in the cluster.

patches.title: [DATA] MIL Knock Indicator
patches.description: MIL Knock Indicator Default Values

patches.title: [PATCH] Daniel_F. 430056 Update Fix
patches.category: Injection Calculation Based on Fuel Factor
patches.description: If the ECU was previously flashed with a 430056 binary from Daniel_F and you can't or don't want to flash 430069 in boot mode, this patch can help you if your engine won't crank. |  | Don't patch this unless you encounter a non starting engine after updating your MS43 to 430069.

patches.title: [PATCH] E3x Vehicle Speed Sensor Accuracy Improvement
patches.description: This will skip the division of the speed sensor signal in ECU code to make the vehicle speed reading more accurate with older BMW speed sensors located inside the rear differential. |  | Very handy if you install M54 engine into E30 or E34 and want to keep the VS sensor of the rear axle differential. Set c_vs_fac to ~1096 impulses per kilometer.

patches.title: [PATCH] Fuel Cut Table Switch Over Cruise Control
patches.description: Instead of checking for the AC compressor relay state, the chose of deceleration maps for ignition and injection will be depending on cruise control main switch (green LED in cluster). |  | Ignition angle change limitation is still depending on AC on/off.

patches.title: [PATCH] Launch Control & Rolling Anti Lag
patches.description: Implements code for the launch control and rolling anti lag feature

patches.title: [DATA] LC & RAL Default Values
patches.description: Implements launch control and rolling anti lag default values

patches.title: [PATCH] MAF Based Full Load Enrichment
patches.description: This patch reworks the PVS depending full load detection so that the injection full load is controlled by an extended 16x12 ip_ti_fl 3D table and the other full load systems are triggered by a MAF threshold instead of a PVS threshold.

patches.title: [DATA] MAF Based FL Default Values - M54B30
patches.description: Applies the default calibration data for the MAF full load detection patch for M54B30 engine

patches.title: [PATCH] Custom CAN - OLM Boost Gauge
patches.description: This patch adds the calculated manifold pressure to the CAN output to display it on Bosch clusters with the oil level meter option. |  | Set OELNIVEAU_M3 to "aktiv" in cluster coding.
